copy.original_post:
The Witcher 3: Songs of the Past just got a much clearer gameplay showcase.

The 12-minute supercut gives us a proper look at Letten, an early quest, new monsters and how Geralt’s return is shaping up for 2027.

Here’s what stood out ↓
copy.reply:
The biggest takeaway for us is how familiar the quest rhythm still feels while Letten has a very different identity from Velen or Toussaint. The new footage finally makes the expansion feel like a substantial new Witcher 3 chapter rather than just a nostalgic return.
